segments.title: Groundwork for the new pages
context: This segment adds the order requests, the order composables and the order form that the three new order pages use. It also puts the three pages in the route table and adds an Orders link to the header of every page.
:::accordion
::section What's added

- [`fetchOrders()`](code:src/api/orders.ts#fetchOrders): added a new function that sends a `GET` request to [`/orders`](code:src/api/orders.ts#L4) with [`request()`](code:src/api/orders.ts#L4) and returns the orders.
- [`fetchOrder()`](code:src/api/orders.ts#fetchOrder): added a new function that sends a `GET` request to [`/orders/${orderId}`](code:src/api/orders.ts#L6) and returns one order.

- [`createOrder()`](code:src/api/orders.ts#createOrder): added a new function that sends a [`POST`](code:src/api/orders.ts#L9) request to [`/orders`](code:src/api/orders.ts#L9) with [the draft as its JSON body](code:src/api/orders.ts#L9).

- [`updateOrder()`](code:src/api/orders.ts#updateOrder): added a new function that sends a [`PUT`](code:src/api/orders.ts#L12) request to [`/orders/${order.id}`](code:src/api/orders.ts#L12) with [the order as its JSON body](code:src/api/orders.ts#L12).

- [`useOrders()`](code:src/composables/use-orders.ts#useOrders): added a new composable that loads every order with [`useQuery`](code:src/composables/use-orders.ts#L7) under the key [`ORDERS_QUERY_KEY`](code:src/composables/use-orders.ts#L4), with [`fetchOrders`](code:src/composables/use-orders.ts#L7) as its query function.

- [`useOrder()`](code:src/composables/use-orders.ts#useOrder): added a new composable that loads one order with [`useQuery`](code:src/composables/use-orders.ts#L11) under [`[...ORDERS_QUERY_KEY, orderId]`](code:src/composables/use-orders.ts#L11), with a query function that calls [`fetchOrder(orderId)`](code:src/composables/use-orders.ts#L11).
- [`useCreateOrder()`](code:src/composables/use-orders.ts#useCreateOrder): added a new composable that creates an order.
- Runs [`createOrder`](code:src/composables/use-orders.ts#L17) as the mutation function of [`useMutation`](code:src/composables/use-orders.ts#L16).
- Calls [`queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ORDERS_QUERY_KEY })`](code:src/composables/use-orders.ts#L18) when the request succeeds.
- [`useUpdateOrder()`](code:src/composables/use-orders.ts#useUpdateOrder): added a new composable that saves a changed order.
- Runs [`updateOrder`](code:src/composables/use-orders.ts#L25) as the mutation function of [`useMutation`](code:src/composables/use-orders.ts#L24).
- Calls [`queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ORDERS_QUERY_KEY })`](code:src/composables/use-orders.ts#L26) when the request succeeds.
- [`Order`](code:src/types/order.ts#Order): added a new interface for an order, with the types [`OrderStatus`](code:src/types/order.ts#L1) and [`OrderDraft`](code:src/types/order.ts#L11) beside it.
- Holds [an `id`, a `customerId`, a `productId`, a `quantity` and a `status`](code:src/types/order.ts#L4-8).
- Types the status as [`"pending" | "shipped"`](code:src/types/order.ts#L1).
- Makes [`OrderDraft` the fields of `Order` without `id`](code:src/types/order.ts#L11).
- [`<OrderForm />`](code:src/views/orders/components/OrderForm.vue#OrderForm): added a new component that edits the customer, the product and the quantity of an order draft.

- Takes the props [`initialDraft`, `submitLabel` and `isSaving`](code:src/views/orders/components/OrderForm.vue#L8), and emits [`submit` with a draft](code:src/views/orders/components/OrderForm.vue#L9).
- Copies the first draft into [`reactive({ ...props.initialDraft })`](code:src/views/orders/components/OrderForm.vue#L11).
- Binds a [`<select v-model="draft.customerId">`](code:src/views/orders/components/OrderForm.vue#L22) to the customers from [`useCustomers()`](code:src/views/orders/components/OrderForm.vue#L12).
- Binds a [`<select v-model="draft.productId">`](code:src/views/orders/components/OrderForm.vue#L25) to the products from [`useProducts()`](code:src/views/orders/components/OrderForm.vue#L13).
- Binds an [`<input v-model.number="draft.quantity" type="number" min="1">`](code:src/views/orders/components/OrderForm.vue#L28).
- Emits [`submit` with a copy of the draft](code:src/views/orders/components/OrderForm.vue#L16) when [the form is submitted](code:src/views/orders/components/OrderForm.vue#L21).
- Disables the [`<BaseButton>`](code:src/views/orders/components/OrderForm.vue#L29) while [`isSaving`](code:src/views/orders/components/OrderForm.vue#L29) is `true`.
::section What's modified
- [`router`](code:src/router.ts#router): modified the route config to render the three order pages inside [`RootLayout`](code:src/router.ts#L15).
- Renders [`ViewOrdersPage`](code:src/router.ts#L19) at [`orders`](code:src/router.ts#L19).
- Renders [`CreateOrderPage`](code:src/router.ts#L20) at [`orders/new`](code:src/router.ts#L20).
- Renders [`EditOrderPage`](code:src/router.ts#L21) at [`orders/:orderId/edit`](code:src/router.ts#L21).
- [`<RootLayout />`](code:src/views/RootLayout.vue#RootLayout): modified the component to render a [`<RouterLink to="/orders">Orders</RouterLink>`](code:src/views/RootLayout.vue#L15) in the header.

waypoints.title: Added `fetchOrders()` to request every order
waypoints.reading: The author added a function `fetchOrders()` that sends a `GET` request to `/orders` and returns the orders of the response. [`useOrders()` passes it to `useQuery` as its query function](code:src/composables/use-orders.ts#L7), so that [`<ViewOrdersPage />`](code:src/views/orders/ViewOrdersPage.vue#L5) can list the orders.

waypoints.title: Added `fetchOrder()` to request one order by its id
waypoints.reading: The author added a function `fetchOrder()` that sends a `GET` request to `/orders/<id>` and returns that one order. [`useOrder()` calls it in its query function](code:src/composables/use-orders.ts#L11), so that [`<EditOrderPage />`](code:src/views/orders/EditOrderPage.vue#L10) can load the order it edits.

findings.title: `fetchOrder()` puts the order id into the path without encoding it
findings.reading: [`fetchOrder()` writes the id into the URL as it is](code:src/api/orders.ts#L6). An id with a `/` or a `?` in it would change the path the request goes to. `encodeURIComponent()` keeps the id one path segment, whatever it holds, for the cost of one call. [`updateOrder()` builds its URL the same way](code:src/api/orders.ts#L12).

waypoints.title: Added `createOrder()` to send a new order
waypoints.reading: The author added a function `createOrder()` that sends a `POST` request to `/orders` with the draft as its JSON body, and returns the order the server created. [`useCreateOrder()` runs it as its mutation function](code:src/composables/use-orders.ts#L17), so that [`<CreateOrderPage />`](code:src/views/orders/CreateOrderPage.vue#L13) saves a new order through it.

waypoints.title: Added `updateOrder()` to save a changed order
waypoints.reading: The author added a function `updateOrder()` that sends a `PUT` request to `/orders/<id>` with the whole order as its JSON body, and returns the order the server saved. [`useUpdateOrder()` runs it as its mutation function](code:src/composables/use-orders.ts#L25), so that [`<EditOrderPage />`](code:src/views/orders/EditOrderPage.vue#L14) saves its changes through it.

findings.title: `updateOrder()` sends back the status the form loaded
findings.reading: [`updateOrder()` sends the whole order as the `PUT` body](code:src/api/orders.ts#L12), `status` included. [The edit page builds that order from the draft the form emits](code:src/views/orders/EditOrderPage.vue#L14), and [the form copies the order as it was loaded](code:src/views/orders/components/OrderForm.vue#L11). If the warehouse ships the order while the form is open, saving sends `"pending"` back. The server is not in this repository, so I could not confirm that it writes the `status` a `PUT` sends.
trace: A staff member opens `/orders/42/edit` for a pending order, and the warehouse marks the order shipped while the form is open.
[`useOrder("42")`](code:src/views/orders/EditOrderPage.vue#L10) loaded `status: "pending"`, and [the form copies it into its draft](code:src/views/orders/components/OrderForm.vue#L11).
findings.solution:
export const updateOrder = ({ id, customerId, productId, quantity }: Order): Promise<Order> =>
  request<Order>(`/orders/${id}`, { method: "PUT", body: JSON.stringify({ customerId, productId, quantity }) })

waypoints.title: Added the query key of the orders
waypoints.reading: The author added a constant `ORDERS_QUERY_KEY` that holds `["orders"]`. [`useOrders()` loads the list under it](code:src/composables/use-orders.ts#L7), and [`useOrder()` loads one order under a key that starts with it](code:src/composables/use-orders.ts#L11). So [one call to `invalidateQueries()`](code:src/composables/use-orders.ts#L18) marks the list and every single order as stale.

waypoints.title: Added `useOrders()` to load every order
waypoints.reading: The author added a composable `useOrders()` that loads every order with `useQuery`, under the key `["orders"]`, with [`fetchOrders()`](code:src/api/orders.ts#fetchOrders) as its query function. [`<ViewOrdersPage />`](code:src/views/orders/ViewOrdersPage.vue#L5) calls it, so that the page lists the orders and shows a message while they load.

waypoints.title: Added `useOrder()` to load one order by its id
waypoints.reading: The author added a composable `useOrder()` that loads one order with `useQuery`, under a key of `"orders"` and the id, with a query function that calls [`fetchOrder()`](code:src/api/orders.ts#fetchOrder). [`<EditOrderPage />`](code:src/views/orders/EditOrderPage.vue#L10) calls it with the id from the URL, so that the page fills its form with the saved order.

waypoints.title: Added `useCreateOrder()` to create an order
waypoints.reading:
The author added a composable `useCreateOrder()` that returns a mutation that:

- sends the draft with [`createOrder()`](code:src/api/orders.ts#createOrder)
- marks every query under `["orders"]` as stale when the request succeeds

[`<CreateOrderPage />`](code:src/views/orders/CreateOrderPage.vue#L10) calls it, so that the orders list loads again after a new order is saved.

children.title: Added the read of the query client
children.reading: The author added a call to `useQueryClient()` that returns the `QueryClient` the app installs with `VueQueryPlugin`. [The success callback of the mutation calls `invalidateQueries()` on it](code:src/composables/use-orders.ts#L18).

children.title: Added the mutation that creates an order
children.reading: The author added a call to `useMutation` with [`createOrder()`](code:src/api/orders.ts#createOrder) as its mutation function, and an `onSuccess` callback that calls `invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["orders"] })`. The callback marks the orders as stale, so that [`useOrders()`](code:src/composables/use-orders.ts#L7) loads the list again after a new order is saved.

waypoints.title: Added `useUpdateOrder()` to save a changed order
waypoints.reading:
The author added a composable `useUpdateOrder()` that returns a mutation that:

- sends the order with [`updateOrder()`](code:src/api/orders.ts#updateOrder)
- marks every query under `["orders"]` as stale when the request succeeds

[`<EditOrderPage />`](code:src/views/orders/EditOrderPage.vue#L11) calls it, so that the list and the edited order load again after the save.

children.title: Added the read of the query client
children.reading: The author added a call to `useQueryClient()` that returns the `QueryClient` the app installs with `VueQueryPlugin`. [The success callback of the mutation calls `invalidateQueries()` on it](code:src/composables/use-orders.ts#L26).

children.title: Added the mutation that saves an order
children.reading: The author added a call to `useMutation` with [`updateOrder()`](code:src/api/orders.ts#updateOrder) as its mutation function, and an `onSuccess` callback that calls `invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ["orders"] })`. The callback marks the list and the saved order as stale, so that [`useOrders()`](code:src/composables/use-orders.ts#L7) and [`useOrder()`](code:src/composables/use-orders.ts#L11) load them again.

waypoints.title: Modified the router to add the three order pages
waypoints.reading:
The author modified the router `router` to add three child routes of the layout:

- `orders` renders [`ViewOrdersPage`](code:src/views/orders/ViewOrdersPage.vue#ViewOrdersPage)
- `orders/new` renders [`CreateOrderPage`](code:src/views/orders/CreateOrderPage.vue#CreateOrderPage)
- `orders/:orderId/edit` renders [`EditOrderPage`](code:src/views/orders/EditOrderPage.vue#EditOrderPage), which [reads `route.params.orderId`](code:src/views/orders/EditOrderPage.vue#L9)

`src/main.ts` installs this router with `app.use(router)`, so that the three pages open at these paths inside [`RootLayout`](code:src/views/RootLayout.vue#RootLayout).

waypoints.title: Added the type of the order status
waypoints.reading: The author added a type `OrderStatus` that is `"pending"` or `"shipped"`. [`Order` types its `status` with it](code:src/types/order.ts#L8), and [the create page starts a new order as `"pending"`](code:src/views/orders/CreateOrderPage.vue#L7).

waypoints.title: Added the type of an order
waypoints.reading: The author added an interface `Order` with an `id`, a `customerId`, a `productId`, a `quantity` and a `status` of type [`OrderStatus`](code:src/types/order.ts#OrderStatus). [The order requests return it](code:src/api/orders.ts#L4-12), and [`<EditOrderPage />` passes the loaded order to the form](code:src/views/orders/EditOrderPage.vue#L23).

waypoints.title: Added the type of an order draft
waypoints.reading: The author added a type `OrderDraft` that is [`Order`](code:src/types/order.ts#Order) without its `id`. [`<OrderForm />` edits one](code:src/views/orders/components/OrderForm.vue#L8) and [`createOrder()` sends one](code:src/api/orders.ts#L8), because the server gives a new order its id.

waypoints.title: Modified `<RootLayout />` to link to the orders
waypoints.reading: The author modified the component `<RootLayout />` to render a `<RouterLink to="/orders">` with the text `Orders` in the header, between `Products` and `Help`. [The router renders `ViewOrdersPage` at that path](code:src/router.ts#L19), so that a staff member can reach the orders from every page.

waypoints.title: Added `<OrderForm />` to edit the fields of an order
waypoints.reading:
The author added a component `<OrderForm />` that:

- copies `initialDraft` into a reactive draft
- binds the customers and the products to two `<select>` elements, and the quantity to a number `<input>`
- emits `submit` with a copy of the draft when the form is submitted
- disables its button while `isSaving` is `true`

[`<CreateOrderPage />`](code:src/views/orders/CreateOrderPage.vue#L20) and [`<EditOrderPage />`](code:src/views/orders/EditOrderPage.vue#L23) both render it, so that the two pages share one set of fields.
waypoints.needsAttention: Both order pages build on this form: it holds the draft a staff member edits and emits it to the page that saves it, so [creating](code:src/views/orders/CreateOrderPage.vue#L13) and [editing](code:src/views/orders/EditOrderPage.vue#L14) an order send what this form collects.

children.title: Added the props and the event of the form
children.reading: The author added three props, `initialDraft`, `submitLabel` and `isSaving`, and one event, `submit`, that carries an [`OrderDraft`](code:src/types/order.ts#OrderDraft). [The create page](code:src/views/orders/CreateOrderPage.vue#L20) and [the edit page](code:src/views/orders/EditOrderPage.vue#L23) pass the props and listen to `@submit`, so that one form creates and edits an order.

children.title: Added the draft of the form
children.reading: The author added a `reactive()` copy of the `initialDraft` prop. [The two `<select>` elements](code:src/views/orders/components/OrderForm.vue#L22-27) and [the quantity `<input>`](code:src/views/orders/components/OrderForm.vue#L28) write into it through `v-model`, and [the submit handler emits a copy of it](code:src/views/orders/components/OrderForm.vue#L16).

findings.title: Should the edit form take the order again when it reloads?
findings.reading: [`reactive({ ...props.initialDraft })`](code:src/views/orders/components/OrderForm.vue#L11) copies the prop once, when the form is set up. [The edit page passes the loaded order](code:src/views/orders/EditOrderPage.vue#L23), and `useQuery` loads that order again when the window gets the focus back after its 30 seconds of `staleTime` in `src/lib/query-client.ts`. The form then keeps the values it first showed. Is it meant to keep what the staff member typed over a newer order from the server?

children.title: Added the customers of the customer list
children.reading: The author added a call to [`useCustomers()`](code:src/composables/use-customers.ts#L6-8) that gives the customers. [The customer `<select>` renders one `<option>` per customer](code:src/views/orders/components/OrderForm.vue#L23).

children.title: Added the products of the product list
children.reading: The author added a call to [`useProducts()`](code:src/composables/use-products.ts#L6-8) that gives the products. [The product `<select>` renders one `<option>` per product](code:src/views/orders/components/OrderForm.vue#L26).

children.title: Added the submit handler of the form
children.reading: The author added a function `handleSubmit()` that emits `submit` with a copy of the draft. [The `<form>` runs it when it is submitted](code:src/views/orders/components/OrderForm.vue#L21), so that the page gets the edited draft and not the reactive object the form keeps changing.

findings.title: `handleSubmit()` emits a draft with no customer and no product
findings.reading: [The create page starts the draft with `customerId: ""` and `productId: ""`](code:src/views/orders/CreateOrderPage.vue#L7). [Neither `<select>` is `required`](code:src/views/orders/components/OrderForm.vue#L22-27), and [`handleSubmit()` emits the draft](code:src/views/orders/components/OrderForm.vue#L16) without checking either field. So a staff member who submits before picking sends an order with two empty ids. Adding `required` to [the customer `<select>`](code:src/views/orders/components/OrderForm.vue#L22) and [the product `<select>`](code:src/views/orders/components/OrderForm.vue#L25) also lets the browser name the empty field.
trace: A staff member opens `/orders/new`, types a quantity and submits without picking a customer or a product.

children.title: Added the submit event of the form
children.reading: The author added a `@submit.prevent` listener that runs [`handleSubmit()`](code:src/views/orders/components/OrderForm.vue#L15-17) and stops the page reload. [The `<BaseButton>` is disabled while the order saves](code:src/views/orders/components/OrderForm.vue#L29), and it submits the form because [it renders a `<button>` with no `type`](code:src/components/ui/BaseButton.vue#L7).

children.title: Added one option per customer
children.reading: The author added a `v-for` that renders one `<option>` per customer, with the id as its value and the name as its text. [The customers come from `useCustomers()`](code:src/views/orders/components/OrderForm.vue#L12).

children.title: Added one option per product
children.reading: The author added a `v-for` that renders one `<option>` per product, with the id as its value and the name as its text. [The products come from `useProducts()`](code:src/views/orders/components/OrderForm.vue#L13).

segments.title: New CreateOrderPage
context: This segment adds the page that creates an order. The page opens the order form with a quantity of one, saves the new order when the form is submitted, and goes back to the orders list.
:::accordion
::section What's added
- [`<CreateOrderPage />`](code:src/views/orders/CreateOrderPage.vue#CreateOrderPage): added a new page component that creates an order.
- Renders [`<OrderForm>`](code:src/views/orders/CreateOrderPage.vue#L20) with the submit label [`"Create"`](code:src/views/orders/CreateOrderPage.vue#L20).
- Starts the form from [`EMPTY_DRAFT`](code:src/views/orders/CreateOrderPage.vue#L7), a draft with [`quantity: 1` and `status: "pending"`](code:src/views/orders/CreateOrderPage.vue#L7).
- Gets the mutation [`saveOrder`](code:src/views/orders/CreateOrderPage.vue#L10) from [`useCreateOrder()`](code:src/views/orders/CreateOrderPage.vue#L10).

- Calls [`saveOrder(draft)`](code:src/views/orders/CreateOrderPage.vue#L13) on the form's [`@submit`](code:src/views/orders/CreateOrderPage.vue#L20), and [`router.push("/orders")`](code:src/views/orders/CreateOrderPage.vue#L13) when the save succeeds.
- Disables the form button through [`:is-saving="isPending"`](code:src/views/orders/CreateOrderPage.vue#L20) while the order saves.

waypoints.title: Added `<CreateOrderPage />` to create an order
waypoints.reading:
The author added a page component `<CreateOrderPage />` that:

- renders [`<OrderForm />`](code:src/views/orders/components/OrderForm.vue#OrderForm) with the empty draft and the label `Create`
- creates the order with [`useCreateOrder()`](code:src/composables/use-orders.ts#useCreateOrder) when the form emits `submit`
- opens `/orders` when the save succeeds

[The router renders it at `/orders/new`](code:src/router.ts#L20), and [the orders list links to it](code:src/views/orders/ViewOrdersPage.vue#L13), so that a staff member can add an order.

children.title: Added the draft a new order starts from
children.reading: The author added a constant `EMPTY_DRAFT` with no customer, no product, a `quantity` of `1` and the `status` `"pending"`. [The page passes it to the form as `:initial-draft`](code:src/views/orders/CreateOrderPage.vue#L20), so that the quantity field starts at [the lowest value it takes](code:src/views/orders/components/OrderForm.vue#L28).

children.title: Added the router of the page
children.reading: The author added a call to `useRouter()` that returns the router of the app. [The success callback of the save calls `router.push("/orders")`](code:src/views/orders/CreateOrderPage.vue#L13).

children.title: Added the mutation that creates the order
children.reading: The author added a call to [`useCreateOrder()`](code:src/composables/use-orders.ts#useCreateOrder) that gives the function `saveOrder` and the flag `isPending`. [The submit handler calls `saveOrder`](code:src/views/orders/CreateOrderPage.vue#L13), and [the form disables its button while `isPending` is `true`](code:src/views/orders/CreateOrderPage.vue#L20).

children.title: Added the submit handler that saves the new order
children.reading: The author added a function `handleSubmit()` that calls `saveOrder(draft)` with an `onSuccess` callback that calls `router.push("/orders")`. [The form emits `submit` with the draft](code:src/views/orders/components/OrderForm.vue#L16), and [the page listens to it with this handler](code:src/views/orders/CreateOrderPage.vue#L20), so that the staff member is back on the orders list once the order is saved.

findings.title: `handleSubmit()` shows nothing when creating the order fails
findings.reading: [`request()` throws an `ApiError` for a response that is not ok](code:src/api/client.ts#L14). `handleSubmit()` passes `saveOrder()` an `onSuccess` and no `onError`, [`useCreateOrder()` has no `onError` either](code:src/composables/use-orders.ts#L16-19), and [the page renders no error](code:src/views/orders/CreateOrderPage.vue#L17-22). So a failed save leaves the staff member on the form with no message, and the button enabled again.
trace: A staff member submits the create form while the API answers `500`.
[`request()` throws `ApiError(500)`](code:src/api/client.ts#L14) with the message `The request failed with status 500.`.
[The mutation of `useCreateOrder()` has no `onError`](code:src/composables/use-orders.ts#L16-19), and [`handleSubmit()` passes only `onSuccess`](code:src/views/orders/CreateOrderPage.vue#L13).
[The page renders the form and no message](code:src/views/orders/CreateOrderPage.vue#L17-22).

children.title: Added the order form with the empty draft
children.reading: The author added an `<OrderForm>` that starts from [the empty draft](code:src/views/orders/CreateOrderPage.vue#L7), shows `Create` on its button, and calls [`handleSubmit()`](code:src/views/orders/CreateOrderPage.vue#L12-14) when it emits `submit`. The button is disabled while [the order saves](code:src/views/orders/CreateOrderPage.vue#L10).

context: This segment adds the page that edits an order. The page loads the order whose id is in the address, shows a message while it loads or when it cannot load, and goes back to the orders list after the save.
:::accordion
::section What's added
- [`<EditOrderPage />`](code:src/views/orders/EditOrderPage.vue#EditOrderPage): added a new page component that edits an order.
- Reads [`orderId`](code:src/views/orders/EditOrderPage.vue#L9) from [`route.params.orderId`](code:src/views/orders/EditOrderPage.vue#L9).
- Loads the order with [`useOrder(orderId)`](code:src/views/orders/EditOrderPage.vue#L10).

- Renders [`

Loading the order…

`](code:src/views/orders/EditOrderPage.vue#L19) while [`isPending`](code:src/views/orders/EditOrderPage.vue#L19) is `true`.

- Renders [`

The order could not be loaded.

`](code:src/views/orders/EditOrderPage.vue#L20) when [`isError`](code:src/views/orders/EditOrderPage.vue#L20) is `true`.

- Renders [`<OrderForm>`](code:src/views/orders/EditOrderPage.vue#L23) with the loaded [`order`](code:src/views/orders/EditOrderPage.vue#L23) and the submit label [`"Save"`](code:src/views/orders/EditOrderPage.vue#L23).

- Calls [`saveOrder({ ...draft, id: orderId })`](code:src/views/orders/EditOrderPage.vue#L14) from [`useUpdateOrder()`](code:src/views/orders/EditOrderPage.vue#L11) on the form's `@submit`, and [`router.push("/orders")`](code:src/views/orders/EditOrderPage.vue#L14) when the save succeeds.

waypoints.title: Added `<EditOrderPage />` to edit an order
waypoints.reading:
The author added a page component `<EditOrderPage />` that:

- loads the order whose id is in the URL with [`useOrder()`](code:src/composables/use-orders.ts#useOrder)
- shows `Loading the order…` while it loads, and `The order could not be loaded.` when the request fails
- renders [`<OrderForm />`](code:src/views/orders/components/OrderForm.vue#OrderForm) with the loaded order and the label `Save`
- saves the edited order under the id from the URL with [`useUpdateOrder()`](code:src/composables/use-orders.ts#useUpdateOrder), then opens `/orders`

[The router renders it at `/orders/:orderId/edit`](code:src/router.ts#L21), and [each row of the orders list links to it](code:src/views/orders/ViewOrdersPage.vue#L20), so that a staff member can change an order.
waypoints.needsAttention: This page puts the order id back into the saved order: the form emits an `OrderDraft`, which has no `id`, and [`updateOrder()` builds its URL from `order.id`](code:src/api/orders.ts#L12).

children.title: Added the route of the page
children.reading: The author added a call to `useRoute()` that returns the route the page was opened at. [The page reads the order id from its params](code:src/views/orders/EditOrderPage.vue#L9).

children.title: Added the router of the page
children.reading: The author added a call to `useRouter()` that returns the router of the app. [The success callback of the save calls `router.push("/orders")`](code:src/views/orders/EditOrderPage.vue#L14).

children.title: Added the order id from the URL
children.reading: The author added a constant `orderId` that holds `String(route.params.orderId)`. [The route `orders/:orderId/edit` sets the param](code:src/router.ts#L21), and the page [loads](code:src/views/orders/EditOrderPage.vue#L10) and [saves](code:src/views/orders/EditOrderPage.vue#L14) the order under it.

children.title: Added the query of the order to edit
children.reading: The author added a call to [`useOrder()`](code:src/composables/use-orders.ts#useOrder) with the id from the URL. It gives the loaded `order` and the flags `isPending` and `isError`. [The template reads the flags](code:src/views/orders/EditOrderPage.vue#L19-20), and [the form starts from the order](code:src/views/orders/EditOrderPage.vue#L23).

children.title: Added the update mutation of the page
children.reading: The author added a call to [`useUpdateOrder()`](code:src/composables/use-orders.ts#useUpdateOrder) that gives the function `saveOrder` and its own `isPending`, renamed to `isSaving` so that it does not clash with the flag of the query. [The submit handler calls `saveOrder`](code:src/views/orders/EditOrderPage.vue#L14), and [the form disables its button while `isSaving` is `true`](code:src/views/orders/EditOrderPage.vue#L23).

children.title: Added the submit handler that saves the edited order
children.reading: The author added a function `handleSubmit()` that calls `saveOrder({ ...draft, id: orderId })` with an `onSuccess` callback that calls `router.push("/orders")`. The draft [the form emits](code:src/views/orders/components/OrderForm.vue#L16) has no `id`, so the handler adds the id from the URL, and [`updateOrder()` puts it in the URL of the `PUT` request](code:src/api/orders.ts#L12).

children.title: Added the loading message of the edit page
children.reading:
The author added a `v-if` that renders `

Loading the order…

` while the query of the order is pending. [The form](code:src/views/orders/EditOrderPage.vue#L23) renders only after the order has loaded, so that it never starts from an `undefined` order.

children.title: Added the error message of the edit page
children.reading:
The author added a `v-else-if` that renders `

The order could not be loaded.

` when the query of the order fails, as it does when [`request()` throws an `ApiError`](code:src/api/client.ts#L14) for an id the server does not have.

children.title: Added the form of the order to edit
children.reading: The author added a `v-else-if="order"` section with the heading `Edit order` and the id, and an `<OrderForm>` that starts from the loaded order, shows `Save` on its button, and calls [`handleSubmit()`](code:src/views/orders/EditOrderPage.vue#L13-15) when it emits `submit`. The button is disabled while [the update saves](code:src/views/orders/EditOrderPage.vue#L11).

waypoints.reading:
The author added a page component `<ViewOrdersPage />` that:

- loads every order with [`useOrders()`](code:src/composables/use-orders.ts#useOrders)
